B.sizing: inverse sample volatility ddof=1 over L daily returns; zero vol ineligible; cap once; residual cash

C.ema: alpha=2/(n+1); seed SMA first n closes; recursive thereafter
C.entry: fast_EMA > slow_EMA and close > max(previous breakout_sessions closes)
C.exit: close < min(previous exit_channel_sessions closes) or fast_EMA <= slow_EMA
C.rank: breakout strength descending then ticker ascending
C.sizing: inverse sample volatility ddof=1; cap once; residual cash

D.basket: daily-rebalanced equal-weight risk-asset return index; initialize 1.0 before first window return
D.breadth: fraction risk assets close > regime_window SMA
D.drawdown: current basket index / maximum index over regime_window+1 index levels - 1
D.risk_off_selection: defensive assets with positive regime-window return; rank descending then ticker
D.risk_on: eligible risk assets above SMA; rank regime-window return descending then ticker
D.sizing: equal weight selected; cap once; residual cash

E.basket: daily-rebalanced equal-weight returns of D risk assets
E.ratio: sample vol last n returns / sample vol last 4n returns; both zero=>1; long only zero=>risk_off
E.sizing: inverse sample volatility over n; cap once; residual cash
E.states: risk_on if ratio < on; risk_off if ratio >= off; neutral otherwise

F.breadth: fraction assets with positive arithmetic mean raw horizon return
F.cash: breadth < threshold or no eligible asset
F.rank: average ranks for ties; normalize rank to [0,1]; mean across horizons
F.sizing: rank points k..1; cap once; residual cash

G.budget: maximum gross desired notional per review/current equity; no carry
G.eligible: abs(drift)>=band and minimum hold met; initial allocation exempt
G.execution: sells before buys; proportionally reduce buys for cash/costs; halt overrides
G.scaling: scale all desired trades proportionally if over budget
